features: FrozenCLS384 versusCLS+patchmean+patchstd1152 from full252RGB; no backbone adaptation;noTTA
preprocessing: StandardScaler then optionalPCA64(whitenFalse,fullSVD); all scaler/PCA/Ridge/kernel/targetmeanstd fit innertrain for selection and outertrain for finalfit
kernel_bandwidth: gamma=1/(2*median squared distance between training PCA features), recomputed inside each fit
screening: Only originalCV. Eligible if fixedblend improves003 and>=3/5folds improve; choose lowest blendRMSE; at most one arm repeated on both predefined repartitions. If noeligiblearm stop.
reference: 003 baseline+compactkernel+Tiny128CNN freshly refit everyfold; compare against saved003 to check drift
data_scope: Development-only split robustness, not independent validation. All 400 rows informed historical feature/model/recipe choices. Kernel inner CV controls only current bandwidth/alpha choices. Exact/D4 groups do not verify source family independence. Conditional bootstrap omits fitting/selection uncertainty; the two partitions reuse the same observations. No holdout evaluation.
preflight_note: Before first model fit, set stable import path for serialized regressor; no statistical settings changed.
